name: Miko Mini
description: A smaller, cheaper sibling to Miko 3 — the same wheeled, screen-faced AI companion format with a smaller non-touch display, one-way video calling, and English-only conversation, aimed at the same 5–10 age range and same Miko Max content ecosystem.

specs.label: Weight
specs.note: no official figure found in this research

specs.label: Camera
specs.note: one-way video calling only; physical lens slider

specs.label: Mobility
specs.note: same category as Miko 3, less range/finesse

specs.label: Age Range
specs.note: same range as Miko 3, not younger-skewed

specs.label: Launched
specs.note: after Miko 3, as the budget/space-friendly option

specs.label: Subscription
specs.note: Same Miko Max tier as Miko 3 — $14.99/mo or $99/yr (help.miko.ai); Miko's own pages list annual price inconsistently

sourcing: Verified against Miko's own site (Miko Mini product page, Miko-vs-Mini comparison page, Help Center tech specs, Miko Mini+ page), independent reviews (9to5Mac, What Katy Said, The Toy Insider's launch coverage), and the same February 2026 Senate/NBC News reporting on Miko's data-exposure incident covered on this catalog's Miko 3 page. Miko Max annual subscription pricing is inconsistent across Miko's own pages. The Miko Mini+ variant's exact spec differences from base Mini are not fully documented by the manufacturer. Whether Miko Mini units were specifically included in the exposed 2026 database is unconfirmed by any source; the senators' own testing was done on a Miko 3 unit, though Miko's parental-control response covers both models.

pricing.summary: MSRP $199, commonly discounted to $149 on Miko's own site. The optional Miko Max subscription costs $14.99/month, but its annual price is inconsistent across Miko's own pages, cited variously as $89, $99, or roughly $8.25/month equivalent.

editorial.heading: Insights
editorial.body: In February 2026, U.S. Senators sent Miko a formal letter after a publicly-exposed database of children's AI-interaction data was found; the senators' testing was done on a Miko 3 unit specifically, and no source confirms or rules out whether Miko Mini fed into the same exposed database, though Miko's resulting parental-control rollout covers both devices.

firmwareCommunity.note: Miko Mini has not released a public SDK, firmware repo, or developer API. Not currently listed in Builds & Mods.
